verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a keyboard shortcuts reference, with Shift+? opening the shortcut key. Community and founder comments point to a fast interface and latency compensation. However, the evidence never mentions a command palette and does not show how comprehensive the shortcuts are. missing for 10: command palette evidence, detail on shortcut coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only operation and no-wait performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: Type Shift `?` to open the key
